title: Mirando City Food Distribution Held Tuesday at Santa Margarita de Escocia Church
excerpt: Mirando City held a food distribution on Tuesday, Nov. 17, at Santa Margarita de Escocia Church, announced live in the morning by Commissioner Jesse Gonzalez. The distribution ran until supplies lasted.
content:
Mirando City held a food distribution on Tuesday, Nov. 17, at Santa Margarita de Escocia Church, Commissioner Jesse Gonzalez announced in a live video that morning.

The distribution was happening until supplies lasted, according to the announcement, which gave no set end time.

Video from the event shows boxes of oranges and crates being loaded and handed out from a truck, with several people on scene. The E.J. Salinas Community Center shared the video Tuesday afternoon.

Source: Commissioner Jesse Gonzalez; E.J. Salinas Community Center, Nov. 17, 2026.
